# Diona
They move around using a dense network of roots. This prevents them from wearing footwear, but also allows them to "root" themselves to the ground to move normally in zero-gravity environments and absorb puddles of liquid from the ground.
Their plant-like metabolisms mean they get hungry slower than other species do, but get thirsty faster. While they can digest the same foods that most other species can, they're also affected by certain botanical reagents (such as EZ nutrient, robust harvest, and weed killer).
Their "blood" is just sap, and therefore isn't replenished when metabolizing iron.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Blunt damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]20% less Slash damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]50% more Heat damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]20% more Shock damage[/color]. Their tree-like exteriors can [color=#ffa500]easily catch fire[/color] when receiving enough Heat damage from *any* source.[/color]
## Make Like A Tree And Leave
Consuming robust harvest will heal a diona, but overdosing will cause them to grow out of control, turning into an immobile tree (and dropping all their equipment). Cutting down the tree will "restore" the Diona to their regular, mobile state.
## Diona Nymphs
After death, a Diona can voluntarily destroy their own body, releasing their internal organs as three "nymphs", with the player taking control of the nymph containing the brain. The brain nymph can speak, but has no hands or inventory.
After 10 minutes, the brain nymph can regrow into a "full" Diona. This will be a brand-new body with a randomized name, appearance, fingerprints, and even DNA, leaving little evidence beyond their word about who they were before.
